# History API


Baseline                                      Widely available                                                                            


This feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions. It’s been available across browsers since July 2015.
-             [              Learn more            ](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")          
-             [              See full compatibility            ](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")          


The **History API** provides access to the browser's session history (not to be confused
with [WebExtensions history](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")) through the [`history`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet") global object. It exposes useful methods and properties that let you navigate back and forth through the user's history, and manipulate the contents of the history stack.


**Note:**This API is only available on the main thread ([`Window`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")). It cannot be accessed in [`Worker`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet") or [`Worklet`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet") contexts.

## In this article

-               [Concepts and usage](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")            
-               [Interfaces](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")            
-               [Examples](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")            
-               [Specifications](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "stylesheet")            
-               [Browser compatibility](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")            
-               [See also](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")            


## [Concepts and usage](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")

Moving backward and forward through the user's history is done using the [`back()`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg"), [`forward()`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg"), and [`go()`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg") methods.

### [Moving forward and backward](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")

To move backward through history:

js

```page-layout
history.back();
```

This acts exactly as if the user clicked on the **Back** button in their browser
toolbar.

Similarly, you can move forward (as if the user clicked the **Forward** button),
like this:

js

```page-layout
history.forward();
```

### [Moving to a specific point in history](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")

You can use the [`go()`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg") method to load a specific page from session history, identified by its relative position to the current page. (The current page's relative position is
`0`.)

To move back one page (the equivalent of calling [`back()`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")):

js

```page-layout
history.go(-1);
```

To move forward a page, just like calling [`forward()`](/static/client/styles-reference-toc.9b9bd019efd16b86.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg"):

js

```page-layout
history.go(1);
```

Similarly, you can move forward 2 pages by passing `2`, and so forth.

Another use for the `go()` method is to refresh the current page by either passing `0`,
or by invoking it without an argument:

js

```page-layout
// The following statements
// both have the effect of
// refreshing the page
history.go(0);
history.go();
```

You can determine the number of pages in the history stack by looking at the value
of the `length` property:

js

```page-layout
const numberOfEntries = history.length;
```

## [Interfaces](/static/client/styles-left-sidebar.46e37af4d0b5c883.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")
[`History`](/static/client/styles-left-sidebar.46e37af4d0b5c883.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")
Allows manipulation of the browser *session history* (that is, the pages visited
in the tab or frame that the current page is loaded in).
[`PopStateEvent`](/static/client/styles-left-sidebar.46e37af4d0b5c883.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")
The interface of the [`popstate`](/static/client/styles-left-sidebar.46e37af4d0b5c883.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg") event.

## [Examples](/static/client/styles-left-sidebar.46e37af4d0b5c883.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg")

The following example assigns a listener for the [`popstate`](/static/client/styles-page-layout.5a4354f33e894319.css "https://developer.mozilla.org/static/client/circle-play.6ed4ac1fb3c93a04.svg") event. It then illustrates some of the methods of the history object to add, replace, and move within the browser history for the current tab.

js

```page-layout
window.addEventListener("popstate", (event) => {
  alert(
    `location: ${document.location}, state: ${JSON.stringify(event.state)}`,
  );
});

history.pushState({ page: 1 }, "title 1", "?page=1");
history.pushState({ page: 2 }, "title 2", "?page=2");
history.replaceState({ page: 3 }, "title 3", "?page=3");
history.back(); // alerts "location: http://example.com/example.html?page=1, state: {"page":1}"
history.back(); // alerts "location: http://example.com/example.html, state: null"
history.go(2); // alerts "location: http://example.com/example.html?page=3, state: {"page":3}"
```
